environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The SQS queue has a permissive access policy allowing sqs:SendMessage from any AWS principal (Resource: '*'). The upstream API Gateway has no request validation, allowing arbitrary message attributes to be set by any caller. Log output is sent to CloudWatch Logs and consumed by a Splunk forwarder that interprets newline-separated log entries. No input sanitization is applied to message attributes before logging.

config.logging: CloudWatch Logs -> Splunk HEC forwarder (raw TCP, newline-delimited)
